It offers agrochemical intermediates, specialty, mining, and performance chemicals, polymer inputs, and pharmaceutical intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs); casscel, phosphorous derivatives, biocides, and phosphonates; and veterinary APIs. The company is also involved in financing activities. It also exports its products.

GIRIRAJ.NS.d: Giriraj Civil Developers Ltd. is an India-based company primarily engaged in civil construction, operating within the civil contractor segment. The company undertakes contract work for various governments, semi-government entities, corporations, and private organizations. Its services encompass planning, estimation, design, construction, and maintenance across diverse projects.

GKWLIMITED.NS.d: GKW Limited provides industrial warehousing services in India. The company operates through two segments, Warehousing and Investment and Treasury. It leases warehousing facilities; and invests in bank deposits, equity instruments, bonds, fixed deposits, and mutual funds. The company was formerly known as Guest Keen Williams Limited. The company was incorporated in 1931 and is based in Mumbai, India. GKW Limited is a subsidiary of Matrix Commercial Private Limited.

IITL.NS.d: Industrial Investment Trust Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment activities in India. It invests in securities, including shares, mutual funds, debentures, and bonds. The company also provides private equity, margin funding, and loans and advances; and equity trading, stock broking, depository, investment advisory, mutual fund distribution, and business consultancy services.

IWP.NS.d: The Indian Wood Products Company Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker IWP and traded in INR. Its country is India.

KAPSTON.NS.d: Kapston Facilities Management Limited operates as an integrated facilities management company in India. The company offers security, housekeeping, engineering, office support, façade cleaning, pest control, pantry, landscaping and gardening, canine brigade, and e-security services. It serves clients in various industries, such as IT and ITES, schools, hotels, hospitals, shopping malls, manufacturing companies, financial services establishments, infrastructure projects, and residential complexes.

KECL.NS.d: Kirloskar Electric Company Limited manufactures and sells electric products and services in India and internationally. The company operates through Power generation and Distribution, Rotating Machine Group, and Others segments.

KEEPLEARN.NS.d: DSJ Keep Learning Limited is a Mumbai-based provider of educational solutions in India, founded in 1989. It helps run campuses, offers digital learning for professional development, advises institutions on maintaining quality standards, licenses teaching methods and supplies platform-as-a-service tools for campus management. Its clients include universities, academic institutions and individual learners, and it supports research centers with publishing.

KESORAMIND.NS.d: Kesoram Industries Limited manufactures and markets cement products under the Birla Shakti brand in India. It also offers rayon, transparent paper, and filament yarn under the Kesoram Rayon brand. The company was formerly known as Kesoram Industries & Cotton Mills Ltd. and changed its name to Kesoram Industries Limited in 1986. Kesoram Industries Limited was founded in 1919 and is based in Kolkata, India.

KSR.NS.d: KSR Footwear Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker KSR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

NAMAN.NS.d: Naman In-Store (India) Ltd. specializes in manufacturing customized display and retail furniture, store fixtures, and industrial sheet metal fabrication. The company's product offerings include modular office furniture, various metal industrial products such as electrical control panels and battery racks, and other fixtures crafted from wood, metal, and plastic. They provide end-to-end services encompassing product design and development, manufacturing, supply chain management, quality assurance, and installation.

NSIL.NS.d: Nalwa Sons Investments Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in the investment and financing activities in India. It operates through two segments, Investment & Finance, and Trading of Goods. The company primarily holds investments in equity shares of steel manufacturing companies of O.P. Jindal Group. It also invests in shares, stocks, or other securities. The company was formerly known as Jindal Strips Limited. Nalwa Sons Investments Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in New Delhi, India.

ORIENTHOT.NS.d: Oriental Hotels Limited owns, operates, and manages hotels, palaces, and resorts primarily in India. The company's hotel portfolio includes the Taj Coromandel, Chennai; Taj Fisherman's Cove Resort & Spa, Chennai; Taj Malabar Resort & Spa, Cochin; Vivanta, Coimbatore; The Gateway Hotel, Pasumalai, Madurai; Gateway, Coonoor; and The Gateway Hotel, Old Port Road, Mangalore. It also provides accommodation, restaurant, and catering services. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Chennai, India.

OSIAHYPER.NS.d: Osia Hyper Retail Limited runs the Osia Hypermart chain of hypermarkets in India, selling clothing, footwear, cosmetics, handbags, household accessories, FMCG goods, crockery, handicrafts and handloom items. It operates outlets in Gujarat cities including Ahmedabad and Vadodara, supplied from a central distribution facility in Rakhial. Incorporated in 2013, it was formerly Mapple Exim Limited.

PRAKASH.NS.d: Prakash Industries Limited operates as an integrated steel and power company in India. The company produces sponge iron; steel billets and blooms; ferro alloys; wire rods and HB wire products for use in binding wires, GL wires, fencing barbed wires, armored sealed wires for heavy electrical cables, nut bolts, nails, screws, alpine products, wire ropes, wire mesh products, etc.; and TMT bars for construction and infrastructure projects.

PRAMARA.NS.d: Pramara Promotions Ltd. is an India-based integrated manufacturer and solutions provider specializing in the toys and promotional products industry. The company operates as a promotional marketing agency, offering end-to-end solutions from ideation and product development to large-scale manufacturing and global sourcing.

REMSONSIND.NS.d: Remsons Industries Limited manufactures and sells automotive components parts and its products in India. The company offers clutch, accelerator/throttle/gasoline, front and rear parking brake, shift and reverse gear, choke, engine stop, speedometer, fare meter, de-compressor, body, HVAC, door, pull-to-stop, drive change, and seat cables for use in two, three, and four wheelers; and light, medium, and heavy commercial vehicles, as well as in construction, mining, and farm equipment.

RNBDENIMS.NS.d: R&B Denims Ltd, set up in 2010, with its head office in Surat, India, makes and distributes denim textiles and apparel in India. Its fabrics include pure cotton, cotton-polyester and cotton-spandex denim, and its garments include jeans, shorts, skirts, jackets and jumpsuits.

SAKAR.NS.d: Sakar Healthcare Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India. It offers pharmaceutical products in various forms, such as oral liquid syrups and suspensions, cephalosporin dry powder injections, liquid injectable in ampoules and vials, and lyophilized injections, as well as cephalosporin tablets, and capsules. The company also develops oncology products.

SARTELE.NS.d: SAR Televenture Ltd. is an Indian telecommunication infrastructure company providing integrated solutions primarily to telecom network operators, broadband service providers, and enterprises. The company specializes in the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and leasing of 4G and 5G network towers and optical fiber cable systems across India.

SHAH.NS.d: Shah Metacorp Ltd., established in Ahmedabad in 1999, makes and distributes long products from stainless and mild steel, mainly for India. It has two divisions, Stainless Steel Products and Agricultural Products, and its stainless range includes ingots, flat bars, bright bars and equal angle bars.

SHERA.NS.d: Shera Energy Ltd. operates in the non-ferrous metals and electrical equipment industry, primarily manufacturing winding wires and strips from copper, aluminum, and brass. The company's product portfolio includes paper-covered and enameled aluminum and copper conductors, aluminum and copper bus bars, brass rods and wires, and copper and aluminum tubes.

SHILCTECH.NS.d: Shilchar Technologies Limited is an Indian company that manufactures transformers and reactors. They cater to various industries, including power transmission, distribution, and railways. The company is headquartered in Gujarat, India.

SHRADHA.NS.d: Shradha Infraprojects Limited, a real estate construction company, engages in the real estate development business in India. It is involved in the construction of commercial complexes, residential houses, and business premises or civil works, as well as deals in real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Shradha Infraprojects (Nagpur) Limited and changed its name to Shradha Infraprojects Limited. Shradha Infraprojects Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Nagpur, India.

SIGNORIA.NS.d: Signoria Creation Ltd. engages in the manufacture and marketing of women apparels. Its products include kurtis, pants, tops, co-ord sets, dupattas and gowns. The company was founded on September 30, 2019 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India.

SWASTIK.NS.d: Swastik Pipe Ltd. manufactures and exports a range of steel products, primarily focusing on Mild Steel (MS) and Carbon Steel Electric Resistance Welded (ERW) pipes and tubes, which are available in both black and galvanized finishes. The company's product portfolio also includes API Line Pipes, rigid PVC pipes, cold-rolled strips, hollow sections, specialized casing pipes, tubular poles, and solar mounting structures.

SYMBIOTEC.NS.d: Symbiotec Pharmalab Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker SYMBIOTEC and traded in INR. Its country is India.

TIRUPATI-SM.NS.d: SHREE TIRUPATI BALAJEE FIBC INDUSTRIES LIMITED manufactures and sells flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBCs) and woven fabrics. Their products are used for packaging and transporting various goods. The company is based in India.

TMRVL.NS.d: The Mandhana Retail Ventures Limited does not have significant operations. Previously, it was engaged in the designing, retailing, marketing, and distribution of men's and women's wear, and accessories under the Being Human brand name in India and internationally. The company was formerly known as Mandhana Retail Ventures Limited and changed its name to The Mandhana Retail Ventures Limited in September 2016. The Mandhana Retail Ventures Limited was founded in 2000 and is based in Mumbai, India.

VAKRANGEE.NS.d: Vakrangee Limited, a technology company, provides banking, ATM, insurance, financial services, e-governance, e-commerce, and logistics services in India.

VGUARD.NS.d: V-Guard Industries Limited, a consumer electrical company, manufactures, trades, and sells electric and electronic goods in India and internationally. It operates through Electronics, Electrical, and Consumer Durables segments.

VISACHROME.NS.d: VISA Chrome Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker VISACHROME and traded in INR. Its country is India.

VOITHPAPR.NS.d: Voith Paper Fabrics India Limited is an Indian company that manufactures and supplies paper machine clothing. They provide a range of fabrics and felts used in the paper manufacturing process. The company is based in India and is part of the Voith Group.

WELSPUNIND.NS.d: Welspun India Limited manufactures and sells home textile products in India and internationally. It offers solid, yarn-dyed, dobby, and jacquard towels and bath robes; bath rugs/mats, such as cotton, nylon, PET, and polyester filament-based Drylon and Resilon yarn rugs; and printed nylon and polyester bath mats. The company also provides utility bedding and bed sheet products comprising pillow fillers, mattress pads, and down-alternative filled comforters; and fashion bedding products for the bedroom.

WHBRADY.NS.d: WH Brady & Company Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker WHBRADY and traded in INR. Its country is India.
